resources.string: Choose how Lumi looks and works.

Adjusts estimates when using hormonal birth control
See where each type of data is stored
Google Drive backups are not deleted by this action.
Cycles, symptoms and daily logs are stored in this device\'s local database. They are not automatically uploaded to Lumi.
If you enable Google Drive, backups are encrypted on your phone before being uploaded to your account. You can also export an encrypted file. Older ZIP backups are unencrypted.
This integration reads data with your permission. Turning it off in Lumi does not revoke system permissions; you can revoke them in Health Connect.
Social or community features, when enabled, may use external services. They are not part of your local cycle backups.
Local records, settings and reminders will be removed. Backups in Google Drive will not be deleted.
Leave pregnancy mode? Regular cycle estimates will resume. Lumi will not automatically record the reason for this change.
Cycle predictions are not birth control.
